scan.title: Automated CVE Assessment
scan.heading: Automated CVE Assessment #{id}
scan.intro: Results of automatically matching {n} installed packages against the known CVE database. Version matching is performed by a deterministic algorithm, and AI (LLM) evaluates the environmental context to determine actual impact.
scan.syncAppliedDetail: — Last sync {ts} · Enriched CVEs {n} (CVSS updated {c}, new KEV {k}) · Details
scan.syncMissingDetail: — Currently using only the curated CVE DB (25 entries). Latest NVD/KEV not reflected. Go to sync page
scan.untrackedKevTitle: 🚨 {n} KEV CVEs not in curated DB
scan.untrackedKevDesc: Listed in CISA KEV but missing from our curated DB, so they are not auto-matched. Curation review needed:
scan.errorHint: The SecuMS Agent inspection policy must include the following commands:
scan.empty: No matched CVEs. (Based on curated CVE DB)
scan.how1: Stage 1 — Package extraction: normalize {n} packages from rpm -qa output
scan.how2: Stage 2 — CVE matching: deterministic version comparison against the curated CentOS 7 CVE DB
scan.how3: Stage 3 — Backport check: automatically determine patch status from the CentOS release number
scan.how4: Stage 4 — AI evaluation: LLM judges actual impact + priority based on environmental context
scan.how5: Stage 5 — Priority sorting: CISA KEV → unpatched → CVSS → EPSS
scan.howNote: ※ This PoC includes only 26 curated CVEs. In production, the NVD JSON feed should be synced daily to automatically track tens of thousands of CVEs.

scanWin.title: Windows Automated CVE Assessment
scanWin.heading: Windows Automated CVE Assessment #{id}
scanWin.intro: Based on {n} installed hotfixes (KB) and the OS build, this deterministically judges whether known Windows security vulnerabilities (CVE) are patched. Missing security updates (KB) are classified as unpatched (AFFECTED).
scanWin.swMatchTitle: 🧩 {n} potential CVEs in installed software/libraries (review needed)
scanWin.swMatchWarn: ⚠ These are "potential" vulnerabilities based on version ranges. Vendor backport patches (e.g. openssl-1.0.2k-16.el7 may include the fix despite the same version) and actual usage (reachability) of the vulnerable feature are unverified — even if shown as "risky", it may not be. Review before confirming.
scanWin.swNoMatch: 🧩 None of the {n} installed software items matched the software CVE DB (will expand as the DB grows).
scanWin.kevProductDesc: Installed products belong to product families listed in CISA KEV (vulnerabilities exploited in real attacks). Version-unverified advisory — check the version/patch status of these products. (Precise version judgment will expand with NVD sync)
scanWin.swInventoryTitle: 🧩 Installed software inventory ({n}) — click to expand
scanWin.swInventoryDesc: CVE matching for third-party software will be enabled as the software CVE DB is enriched (currently shown as asset inventory).
scanWin.empty: No matched CVEs. (Based on curated Windows CVE DB — no entries targeting this OS build)
scanWin.howTitle: How Windows Automated CVE Assessment Works
scanWin.how1: Stage 1 — Inventory extraction: OS build + installed hotfixes ({n} KBs) + service states
scanWin.how2: Stage 2 — Patch judgment: build UBR ≥ fix UBR or fix KB installed → patched, otherwise unpatched
scanWin.how3: Stage 3 — Condition evaluation: some CVEs weight the attack surface by whether specific services (SMB, Spooler, Netlogon, etc.) are running
scanWin.howNote: ※ This feature includes only curated core Windows Server CVEs. In production, sync the Microsoft Security Update Guide (MSRC) / NVD feeds to keep the KB-CVE mapping current. Per-application (third-party SW) CVEs require expanded inventory collection.

sync.title: CVE Feed Sync
sync.intro: Periodically fetches the NVD (U.S. National Vulnerability Database) modified feed and the CISA KEV (Known Exploited Vulnerabilities) catalog to enrich the curated CVE DB. Core matching fields (package/version/patch) are preserved; only CVSS scores, KEV listing, and descriptions are updated.
sync.noSyncDesc: Sync has never been run. If this environment has internet access, click the [Sync now] button.
sync.offlineStep1: Download the following files on an internet-connected PC:
sync.offlineStep2: Copy both files to the server's data/cve/feeds/ directory
sync.offlineStep3: Run manually on the server: node scripts/sync-cve.js --from-file=data/cve/feeds/nvdcve-1.1-modified.json.gz
sync.untrackedTitle: KEV CVEs not in curated DB ({n})
sync.untrackedDesc: Listed in CISA KEV but not in the curated DB (cve-centos7-curated.json), so they are not auto-matched. If they affect CentOS 7 environments, consider adding them to the curation.
sync.untrackedNone: None. All KEV entries are registered in the curation.

js.confirmDry: Run sync in --dry-run mode? (No DB save, output only)
js.confirmRun: Fetch the latest data from NVD/KEV and update the CVE DB. Proceed?
js.running: Sync running... (may take tens of seconds)
js.confirmReload: Sync complete. Reload the page to refresh statistics?

mgmt.title: CVE Sync Management
mgmt.intro: Enriches the curated CVE DB with NVD (National Vulnerability Database) and CISA KEV feeds. In air-gapped environments, upload feed files obtained from an internet-connected PC to sync.
mgmt.untrackedTitle: ⚠ Untracked KEV — KEV CVEs not in curated DB ({n})
mgmt.untrackedDesc: Listed in CISA KEV but not in the curated DB, so they are not auto-matched. These are operationally important CVEs — consider adding them manually to data/cve/cve-centos7-curated.json.
mgmt.runDesc: Upload an NVD feed file (nvdcve-1.1-modified.json, .json.gz accepted). If run without a file, it attempts a direct internet download (fails in air-gapped environments).
mgmt.dryRun: Dry-run (no actual save, preview changes only)
mgmt.historyEmpty: Sync has not been run yet.
